title: pinalia elongata
intro: Pinalia elongata, commonly known as the Elongated Pinalia or Elongated Orchid, is a species of orchid native to tropical Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and snake bites, thanks to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Pinalia elongata include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, making it a useful remedy for pain relief and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and are responsible for its medicinal properties.
